label: ABOUT · THE CHARACTER SHEET
heading: A curious kid who never stopped asking how things work.
paragraphs: I grew up in Andhra Pradesh, endlessly fascinated by how computers work. That curiosity turned into Computer Science at SRKR, three years shipping a production app at Tata Consultancy Services, and now an MS at Stony Brook focused on AI/ML.
I like owning things end to end: the screen, the API behind it, and the release that puts it in people's hands. Python is my not-so-secret favorite.

items.title: Joins SRKR for B.Tech CSE
items.text: Captains the department football and basketball teams. Joins NSS and ACE.

items.title: Competitive programming
items.text: Rank #448 in Newton's Coding Challenge. HackerRank 5-Star in Python. WorldQuant Applied Data Science I with honors.

items.title: First internship, then ACE leadership
items.text: Web dev intern at Blackbucks. Rises to Senior Body and Helping Hand; runs hackathons for 1,000+ attendees.

items.title: Capstone, graduation, TCS
items.text: Leads a 5-person NLP capstone to 92% accuracy. Joins TCS and starts on NEST Pensions from day one.

items.title: Teaching and freelancing
items.text: Teaches Python to 60+ students. Starts DuYu, a fintech app for a startup.

items.title: Goes full stack
items.text: Ships NotesApp solo: React Native app and FastAPI backend. Starts PassionIsle.

items.title: Stony Brook
items.text: MS CS (AI/ML). Graduate TA for CSE 312. Secretary of the CP Club.
